source_original: Jis a:dmi ka kutta bema:r hai, us a:dmi ko mai ne dekha.
translation: I saw the man whose dog is sick.
alternate_translation: Which man's dog is sick, that man I saw.

source_original: Malu ka hiyi=su?
translation: Is your body well? How are you?

source_original: Saman 'u, mawsa=nami Tehaypaq da.
translation: As for tomorrow, we will go to Taipei.

source_original: Sapah=na 'u, hebaraw ka patas=na.
translation: As for his house, there are many books.

source_original: Laqi gaga 'u, malu (ka hiya).
translation: As for that child, s/he is good.

source_original: Kumu 'u, b-en-arig=na laqi=na ka patas niyi.
translation: As for Kumu, she bought this book for her child.

source_original: Deha laqi niyi 'u, tege'ima ka sewayi=su?
translation: As for these two children, which is your younger sibling?

translation: I will cook the kangaroo that you speared.

source_original: [Nyuntulu-rlu kutja-npa wawirri pantu-rnu] ngatjulu-rlu kapi-rna purra-mi.
translation: I will cook the kangaroo that you speared.

source_original: ŋan̪i wil̪a-ni yat̪a-l̪a ŋana-yi/ yinda-ṇan̪i.
translation: I'll talk to the woman who is crying.

translation: Yudaw who is speaking to a/the guest is from America.
alternate_translation: * The guest to whom Yudaw is talking to, he is from America.

source_original: *Sepeg-un rubiq ka patas 'u, m-en-egay (patas) ka tama=na.
Sepeg-un rubiq ka patas 'u, b-en-egay tama=na.
translation: Her father gave (her) this book which Rubiq will read.

Ga reŋag-an yudaw ga ka lupuŋ 'u, m-en-egay patas rebiq-an.
translation: The guest to whom Yudaw is talking to will give a/the book to Rubiq.

source_original: *Saw 'adi mpeke-geruŋ ka peratu 'u, m-barig=ku.
Saw 'adi mpeke-geruŋ ka peratu 'u, berig-un=mu.
translation: I will buy such a plate as will not break.

source_original: Saw mpe-takur ka laqi 'u, pelekuh-un=na da.
translation: When the child is likely to stumble, he supports the child.
alternate_translation: He supported the child who was likely to stumble.

source_original: Saw 'adi mpeke-geruŋ ka peratu 'u, seku-'un=mu kulu.
translation: I put the plate in a box lest it should break.

translation: The person who killed Rubiq escaped away.

translation: The person who killed Rubiq escaped away.

source_original: S-em-en-teruŋ=ku se'diq [m-en-uway patas rebiq-an].
translation: I met [the man who gave Rubiq a book].

source_original: S-em-en-teruŋ=ku [m-en-uway patas rebiq-an ka se'diq].

translation: As the child will not read, put it away.

translation: When they roasted meat, who were there?

translation: Though rubiq came to see father, father went outside.

source_original: M-iyah=su hini 'u, me-qaras=ku.
translation: If you come, I would be glad.

source_original: T-em-egesa 'uyas kelemukan ka tiwaŋ 'u, t-em-egesa 'uyas nihuŋ ka daway 'uri.
translation: Ciwang taught Taiwanese songs, and Daway taught Japanese songs.

source_original: Pe-kedus-un=ta=na ka 'ita 'u, m-en-da huway yisu kirisuto tehawlaŋ.
translation: That we are made to live by him, it is through the grace of Lord Jesus Christ.

source_original: M-usa sapah rubiq ka kumu 'u, me-kela ka rubiq.
translation: Rubiq knows that Kumu went to Rubiq's house.
